messages:
maria: thinking about adding a one-click 'Emergency pause' in Console to stop routing to a model/route. Need guardrails: who can click, what telemetry to check before/after, auto-unpause TTL, and audit justification. Thoughts?

kevin: +1 on a pause control. my vote is 2-step: pause button -> confirmation modal that requires a short reason. show estimated traffic affected before confirm. :thumbsup:

taylor: we should scope pause to different levels: route, canary cohort, tenant. for canaries, pause should default to just that cohort. TTL should be adjustable per-pause. Dedicated customers might need an approval step.

jamie: UX note — hide the panic controls under a "Safety" menu so not accidental. modal should have checkboxes: [stop accepting new requests], [drain existing requests], [mirror to fallback for verification]. show quick links to relevant traces/metrics.

ops-sre: operational concerns: 1) prevent race when region failover + manual pause happen (idempotency token + last-modifier). 2) emit a structured metric and audit event on pause/unpause, include route, user, reason, scope, result. 3) if drain=true, expose drain progress as a per-route gauge.

maria: example API payload if we expose a pause endpoint (for teams and console to call):

```
{
  "route_id": "route-abc",
  "action": "pause",
  "scope": "route",   // route | canary | tenant
  "drain": true,
  "ttl_s": 3600,
  "reason": "high 5xx rate",
  "requester": "maria",
  "idempotency_key": "uuid-1234"
}
```

kevin: also add a dry_run=true option that does not actually flip traffic but returns a preview: predicted qps impacted, pct of requests, which tenants affected, and estimated cost delta. console should call preview first and show that in modal.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: audit log created for pause by maria at 2399991234. event_id=evt-4982

aj: dashboard/telemetry thoughts: add a small widget for Recent pauses (last 72h), avg pause duration, % of pauses that auto-expired vs manually unpaused, and a list of top reasons. also add an alert when pause TTL expires without a human ack. i'll prototype a wire.

maria: action items: aj will prototype dashboard tile; taylor will draft modal copy and permission matrix; kevin will spec API + preview response; ops-sre will write metric & audit schema; i'll open an RFC with proposed UI mock and an emergency playbook. thanks everyone :heart:

maria: fyi we should also discuss whether pauses require 2-person approval for enterprise routes in the RFC — leaving that as an open question.
